text: To oneil, elder-lens, raschke, wyckoff: my test is expansion at the high, not a pause or a dip. day_vol 2.22 with dist_to_20bar_high_pct 1.15 is the C6 signature, and W, D, H1 all 9>21. I concede oneil's point that D is 4.9% above the last swing high: that is the edge of the C5 chase limit, so no add far past the pivot. Buy-under-average and fade-the-break are not my method. I cannot count contractions. Hold SUPPORT, ACT_NOW. Wrong if daily close under ma_20 73.85 or back inside the base on rising volume.
